public_rationale: The searches did not establish use and permission status for every Marcus work. Contemporaneous Authors Guild guidance explicitly cautioned that Meta's use of every LibGen book was uncertain. That warning limits what catalog membership can prove; it does not show Marcus's statement was false. General evidence about other authors cannot settle his universal claim.
limitations: The cited guidance addresses books generally and does not inventory Marcus's scientific articles.
The Authors Guild is an advocacy organization; its statement is used only to document the acknowledged evidence gap.
A finding of fair use would not itself establish that Marcus granted permission.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Meta used all of Marcus's works in the database without his permission.

statement.excerpt: In every single case, they used them without my permission.
statement.document_title: Meta pirated at least 101 of my books and articles, and tens of millions of others

our_interpretation: 'They' means Meta and 'them' means the Marcus books and scientific articles identified in the preceding LibGen claim.
In context, 'used' means used for Llama training. Merely appearing in LibGen does not establish that use.
'Every single case' covers the whole referenced set, not only some unidentified subset.
'Without my permission' means Marcus did not authorize the use, directly or through someone empowered to authorize it for him. Lack of permission does not by itself decide fair use.
The observation concerns use completed by March 20, 2025. The post supplies no starting date.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish that Meta used every work in the identified Marcus set for training by the post date and that Marcus had not authorized any of those uses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish at least one work in that set that Meta did not use as claimed, or at least one claimed use that Marcus authorized.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A complete identified work list with training-use records and independent permission evidence for every entry, or one verified counterexample showing authorized use or nonuse.
